prerequisites.note: 992 tests, 0 failures. JaCoCo 38% lines / 23% branches (thresholds 35%/20%). Spec at ../tenxengage-blueprint/features/redemption-flow/spec.md confirmed present.

findings.message: Terminal-state guard reads status before acquiring SELECT FOR UPDATE on the RedemptionRequest — two concurrent webhooks can both pass the guard and double-apply.
findings.manualAction: Add a SELECT FOR UPDATE lock on the RedemptionRequest before the terminal-state guard check, or use a DB-level unique constraint on (redemption_request_id, status) transitions.

findings.message: Unchecked cast chain on XTRM API response — NPE if nested keys (data, balance, amount) are absent from response.
findings.manualAction: Add null-safe navigation for each nested key before casting. Throw a typed domain exception on absent fields.

findings.message: maxInFlight check performed before acquiring wallet SELECT FOR UPDATE lock — concurrent submissions can both pass the in-flight guard.
findings.manualAction: Move the inFlight count check to after the wallet lock is acquired.

findings.message: Math.abs(UUID.hashCode()) used as IssuerTransactionId — hash collisions can produce duplicate IDs for different UUIDs.
findings.manualAction: Use a deterministic, collision-free ID derived from the UUID (e.g. truncated hex or a sequence).

findings.message: Signing secret defaults to empty string — no startup alerting if misconfigured. Blank secret silently disables HMAC validation.
findings.manualAction: Add an @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent.class) that logs ERROR and optionally throws if both signing secrets are blank.

findings.message: Repository injected directly into controller — entity construction and DB access belong in the service layer.
findings.manualAction: Move webhook event entity construction into RedemptionWebhookService.

findings.message: Throws raw RuntimeException on XTRM API error — callers cannot distinguish vendor errors from programming errors.
findings.manualAction: Define and throw a typed VendorIntegrationException.

findings.message: RestClient exchange returns a potentially-null body that is immediately dereferenced.
findings.manualAction: Add null check on RestClient response body before accessing nested fields.

findings.message: Pageable.unpaged() loads ALL client catalog configs from DB — unbounded query on large tenants.
findings.fix: Scoped config query to page item IDs using findByClientIdAndRedemptionCatalogItemIdIn.

findings.message: computeNextBatchDate re-queried settingsRepository — duplicate DB call when settings already loaded.
findings.fix: Load settings once per submission; pass BatchCadence directly to computeNextBatchDate(BatchCadence).

findings.message: log.error redundantly included e.getMessage() as placeholder arg alongside Throwable — cleaned to single-arg pattern.
log.error in validateHmac catch block logged only e.getMessage() — no stack trace captured.
findings.fix: Changed to log.error("[step=webhook-hmac-error]", e) to capture full stack trace.

findings.message: In-flight count check before wallet lock in submitPersonalRedemption — same race as submitCompanyRedemption.
findings.manualAction: Move inFlight check after wallet SELECT FOR UPDATE in both submission paths.

findings.message: findOrCreateSettings has a create-race — two concurrent first-access requests can both pass the findByClientId empty check and try to insert.
findings.manualAction: Add a DB unique constraint on (client_id) for tenant_redemption_settings, or use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

TOCTOU: inFlight check before wallet lock in both submission paths
TOCTOU: findOrCreateSettings create-race — needs DB unique constraint on client_id
XtrmVendorService: unchecked cast chain — add null-safe navigation
XtrmVendorService: UUID.hashCode() for IssuerTransactionId — collision risk
RedemptionWebhookController: startup alerting for blank signing secret
RedemptionWebhookController: move repo injection and entity construction to service

findings.message: No startup alerting when XTRM/Xoxoday signing secrets are blank — silent HMAC bypass risk.
findings.manualAction: Add @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent) to warn/throw if both secrets are unset.

findings.message: Public webhook endpoint has no rate limiting — vulnerable to replay flood / resource exhaustion.
findings.manualAction: Add @RateLimiter (Resilience4j) or Spring Security rate-limiting filter on /api/v1/redemption/webhook/**.

findings.message: Idempotency check (findByIdempotencyKey) has a TOCTOU — no DB-level unique constraint enforces idempotency.
findings.manualAction: Add a unique index on (idempotency_key) in the webhook_events table migration.

findings.message: No length or charset guard on idempotencyKey — unbounded string stored directly.
findings.manualAction: Add @Size(max=128) @Pattern(regexp="[\\w\\-]+") to the idempotencyKey path variable.

findings.message: failureReason extracted from vendor payload logged without sanitization — log injection risk.
findings.manualAction: Strip or encode newlines/ANSI in failureReason before logging.

findings.message: validateHmac was package-private — unnecessarily broad access.
maxInFlightRedemptions lacked @NotNull — null was accepted silently, bypassing @Min/@Max.
Returns HTTP 200 OK on webhook receipt — async processing semantics warrant 202 Accepted.
findings.manualAction: Consider returning 202 Accepted once webhook processing is moved to a background queue.

findings.message: PUT /settings performs a partial update — HTTP semantics suggest PATCH.
findings.manualAction: Change @PutMapping to @PatchMapping when the partial-update semantics are confirmed with frontend.

manualActionItems: Add startup alerting for blank signing secrets
Add unique index on idempotency_key in webhook_events migration
Add @Size @Pattern validation on idempotencyKey path variable

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled

findings.summary: Vendor dispatch runs before PROCESSING state is durably committed
findings.details: dispatchItem sets PROCESSING and calls orchestrationService.dispatch inside the same REQUIRES_NEW transaction. Duplicate-dispatch risk if vendor call succeeds and DB commit fails. Risk is dormant today — dispatch always throws (XTRM API not working; Xoxoday is a stub). Deferral documented in code comment.
findings.deferralReason: Dormant — dispatch always throws today (US-05 BE-1: XTRM API not working; US-06 BE-1: Xoxoday stub). Risk only materialises on successful vendor call. Outbox pattern will be implemented when vendor integrations unblock. Code comment added.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — risk gated behind US-05/US-06 blockers; deferred with code comment
findings.recommendation: When US-05/US-06 unblock: persist a pre-committed outbox/dispatchAttempt record and move the vendor call outside the REQUIRES_NEW transaction.

findings.summary: XTRM IssuerTransactionId collapses 128-bit UUID to a collision-prone 32-bit hash
findings.details: Math.abs(request.getId().hashCode()) — 32-bit collision space; Math.abs(MIN_VALUE) stays negative. Risk dormant while XTRM API is blocked.
findings.fixNote: Changed to request.getId().toString() — full UUID string, collision-free.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — fixed: Math.abs(hashCode()) replaced with UUID.toString()

findings.summary: Signed webhook can settle any PROCESSING redemption without vendor-channel validation
findings.details: No check that path vendor matches request's expected settlement channel. Risk dormant today — no requests reach PROCESSING (dispatch blocked), and signing secrets are blank (validateHmac → 403). Deferral documented in code comment.
findings.deferralReason: Dormant — no requests reach PROCESSING today (US-05/US-06 blockers) and blank signing secrets cause HMAC validation to fail for all real vendor callbacks. Vendor-channel validation will be added when dispatch is unblocked by persisting expectedVendor on dispatch. Code comment added.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — risk gated behind US-05/US-06 blockers; deferred with code comment
findings.recommendation: When US-05/US-06 unblock: persist expectedVendor on dispatch and reject callbacks where vendor path ≠ request's stored settlement channel.

# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: branch diff against main
Verdict: needs-attention

- [high] XTRM idempotency key is a 32-bit hash of the redemption UUID (src/main/java/com/tenxengage/app/service/XtrmVendorService.java:59-61)
- [high] Signed webhook can settle any PROCESSING redemption ID without checking expected vendor/reference (src/main/java/com/tenxengage/app/controller/RedemptionWebhookController.java:131-163)
